description: Source code for the DirectiveHandler class in the ANGLE project, handling shader directives such as pragmas, extensions, and versioning.

classes.name: TDirectiveHandler
classes.description: Handles shader directives such as pragmas, extensions, and version settings within the ANGLE shader compiler.

methods.name: getBehavior
methods.description: Converts a string to a TBehavior enum value representing directive behavior.

methods.name: TDirectiveHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the directive handler with extension behavior, diagnostics, shader version, shader type, and debug shader precision support.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Reports an error at a specific source location with a message.

methods.name: handlePragma
methods.description: Processes pragma directives, handling optimization, debug, and invariant pragmas.

methods.name: handleExtension
methods.description: Handles extension directives, enabling or warning about unsupported extensions.

methods.name: handleVersion
methods.description: Sets the shader version if supported, otherwise reports an error.
